fact: Graphic Online reports that NITA put out its draft Data Harmonisation Bill 2025 for public consultation from 19 to 27 November 2025, with the consultation document available on the NITA website at www.nita.gov.gh/publicconsultation.
NITA invited the public to comment on the draft NITA Data Harmonisation Bill 2025, posted on its website, from 19 to 27 November 2025, with responses sent by email.

The World Bank blog says the Business Regulatory Reform unit put the MSME Classification Regulation (2021) on its Public Consultation Portal, where it drew over 1,000 views and suggestions, one of which was adopted in the final regulation.

The World Bank blog says Ghana's Business Regulatory Reform unit runs a Public Consultation Portal through which civil society accesses draft laws and regulatory proposals and BRR officials review comments and poll results.
